description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Wind)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (wind) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can spend an immediate action to alter the course of a ranged weapon already in flight, applying a +2 bonus or -2 penalty on its attack roll. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (wind) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Wind)
